v3.5.10 — HEVC Main 10 Threshold Fix

• Fixed: v3.5.9 blocked HEVC Main 10 (HDR) content on AFTKRT (mt8696, 1.6GB RAM) and AFTMM (mt8695, 1.3GB RAM) even though those devices have enough RAM for libVLC to decode it. The HEVC Main 10 gate now uses total device RAM (>= 1.2GB) instead of device tier, so only truly low-RAM devices (AFTSS at 900MB) are blocked. Content that played before v3.5.9 plays again.
